# Compare Business Healthcover

> Free UK comparison of SME and business health insurance (group private medical insurance) from 2 employees. Introducer to FCA-regulated brokers — not an insurer.

Compare Business Healthcover is a trading name of MASON & HALL DIGITAL LTD (Company No. 17086378). We help UK employers compare SME health insurance and group private medical insurance. We are an introducer, not an insurer; FCA-regulated broker partners obtain quotes. Phone 01484 773038. Site: https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk

## Pages
- [Compare business health insurance for UK SMEs](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/): Compare group private medical insurance for UK SMEs from two employees. Free, no-obligation introductions to FCA-regulated brokers. We are an introducer, not an insurer.
- [Small company health insurance UK](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/small-company-health-insurance/): Small company and SME group health insurance in the UK, often from two employees. Who qualifies, whether it is worthwhile, and how micro-businesses compare cover.
- [Business health insurance](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/business-health-insurance/): What UK business health insurance is, how group PMI works, what it covers, who can buy it, and how to compare. Free introduction to FCA-regulated brokers. We are not an insurer.
- [Business health insurance guide for UK SMEs](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/health-insurance-guide/): Plain-English guide to business and SME health insurance in the UK: eligibility, cost drivers, tax, underwriting, and how to choose a group scheme.
- [Can a UK company with 2 employees get group health insurance?](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/sme-health-insurance-2-employees/): Yes — many UK group health insurance schemes start at two employees. How two-person limited companies compare SME PMI, who counts as an employee, and when individual cover is the right product.
- [How much does business health insurance cost in the UK?](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/sme-health-insurance-cost/): There is no single UK price for business or SME group health insurance. This is general information for employers. A broker quote is the figure that matters. We are an introducer, not an insurer.
- [Is employer health insurance tax deductible in the UK?](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/business-health-insurance-tax/): Outline of UK tax treatment of employer-paid group PMI: corporation tax, P11D benefit in kind, and why directors should confirm with an accountant. Not tax advice.
- [Guide to business health insurance renewals in the UK](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/business-health-insurance-renewals/): How UK group PMI renewals work: why premiums rise, when to start comparing, and how to switch without a gap in cover. For SME employers approaching renewal.
- [Group or personal health insurance for company directors?](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/director-group-health-insurance/): Should a UK company director use group PMI or personal private medical insurance? How director-only groups, P11D, and dependants usually work. Information only.
- [How UK small business health insurance providers differ](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/small-business-health-insurance-providers/): How UK SME group PMI providers typically differ: hospital lists, outpatient limits, cancer pathways and underwriting. Sourced explainers for Bupa, AXA Health, Aviva and Vitality. Not a ranking.
- [Bupa business health insurance for UK SMEs](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/bupa-business-health-insurance/): How Bupa describes UK small-business health insurance for 2–249 employees: cover levels, facility access and typical exclusions. Sourced from Bupa. Not a recommendation.
- [AXA Health business health insurance for UK SMEs](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/axa-business-health-insurance/): How AXA Health describes UK small-business health insurance for 1–249 employees: modular options, family add-ons and typical exclusions. Sourced from AXA Health. Not a recommendation.
- [Aviva business health insurance for UK SMEs](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/aviva-business-health-insurance/): How Aviva describes Solutions group PMI for 1–249 employees, including core cover and the overlap with Optimum from 100 staff. Sourced from Aviva. Not a recommendation.
- [Vitality business health insurance for UK SMEs](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/vitality-business-health-insurance/): How Vitality describes UK business health insurance for companies with up to 249 employees, including rewards and a separate corporate range. Sourced from Vitality. Not a recommendation.
- [About Compare Business Healthcover](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/about-us/): Compare Business Healthcover is an introducer for UK SME group health insurance, operated by MASON & HALL DIGITAL LTD. FCA-regulated broker partners arrange policies.
- [How Compare Business Healthcover compares group cover](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/how-we-compare/): Compare Business Healthcover is an introducer for UK SME group health insurance. We are not FCA authorised. FCA-regulated broker partners obtain quotes. Panels vary.
- [How we write this site](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/editorial-policy/): How Compare Business Healthcover writes SME health insurance guides: general information, sourced insurer pages, no invented prices or rankings. Introducer, not an insurer.
- [Family members on a UK business health scheme](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/family-health-insurance/): How UK SME group schemes treat spouses and children as dependants. This is not a consumer family PMI page — it is for employers extending group cover.
- [Health cover when your SME team includes older employees](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/senior-health-insurance/): How SME group PMI treats mature and older employees: age loadings, underwriting and why you should not default to a consumer over-50s product for staff.
- [International medical cover for UK business teams](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/international-health-insurance/): When UK SMEs need worldwide or expatriate medical cover alongside domestic group PMI. For employers with overseas staff or frequent business travel — not holiday travel insurance.
- [Corporate health insurance for larger UK companies](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/corporate-health-insurance/): Corporate group PMI for larger UK workforces: tiered benefits, account management and medical history disregarded options. Compare via FCA-regulated brokers.
- [Health insurance if you are self-employed](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/self-employed-health-insurance/): Self-employed and sole traders usually need individual PMI, not SME group cover. How that differs from company schemes and when a limited company should use group PMI instead.
- [What does business health insurance cover?](https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/insurance-types/): What UK business health insurance typically covers and does not: inpatient, outpatient, cancer, mental health, hospital lists and extras. The quote wording is the authority.
